required_before_model_import: manifest source provenance equals immutable amendment source_provenance

batch1_sensitivity.envelope: metric-specific abs(B8 microbatch0 minus reconstructed B1); expand bootstrap bounds by envelope
batch1_sensitivity.reconstruction: eight B1 CE-numerator gradients summed per family microbatch 0 then divided by exact total supervised tokens

bootstrap.method: four microbatches independently resampled with replacement within each family; cross-family cosine pairs are not independent rows

composition_source_scope: Existing legitimate synthetic TRAIN source only; canonical composition labels are explicit source mappings, not a claim of independent transfer.

decision_rule.GRADIENT_CONFLICT_DEPRIORITIZED: each historical combined protected-family B1-expanded lower bound is >=0, and B1 sensitivity cannot move negative-pair frequency across 0.10.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: any other valid pattern, opposite B1-expanded protected signs, or any decision boundary reversible under a metric-specific B1 envelope.
decision_rule.INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE: identity, serialization, mapping, nonfinite, source, receipt, or partial-evidence failure
decision_rule.LOCAL_INTERFERENCE_SUPPORTED: each weak branch needs point estimate < -0.05 and B1-expanded bootstrap upper < 0 for >=3/5 families, OR historical token-weighted combined protected macro point estimate < -0.05 and B1-expanded upper < 0; opposed protected signs are INCONCLUSIVE.

execution_amendment.change: Remove redundant runtime existence/hash read of TRAIN.jsonl; require exact equality between frozen manifest source provenance and this immutable source_provenance contract before model import.

execution_determinism.external_wallclock_cap: The required external launcher exports E03_EXTERNAL_CAP_ENFORCED=1 and kills the process group at 1500 seconds; worker refuses direct invocation.
execution_determinism.gradient_zeroing: model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) before and after every microbatch
execution_determinism.label_mask: ignore_index=-100 user tokens; all assistant tokens supervised

execution_repair.change: Resolve config and binding paths relative to repository root before pre-import hash lookup.
execution_repair.root_cause: V3 invoked relative config and binding paths but calculated a repository-relative identity from an absolute root without canonicalizing the input paths.

gradient_algebra.family: g_f = sum_b( supervised_token_count_b * g_b ) / sum_b supervised_token_count_b
gradient_algebra.microbatch: g_b = grad_FP32(sum shifted assistant-token CE / supervised_token_count_b)

lora_allowlist_basis.base_config_static_probe: RunPod base config.json num_hidden_layers=36 model_type=qwen3; no model import
lora_allowlist_basis.runtime_requirement: actual sorted named_parameter set must equal this exact allowlist before any backward pass

lora_allowlist_canonicalization: SHA256(UTF-8 JSON compact serialization of lexicographically sorted exact parameter names)

loss_equivalence.legacy: FP32 cross_entropy over shifted logits with ignore_index=-100 reduction=sum divided by supervised-token count
loss_equivalence.v2: select nonignored shifted labels first; convert only selected logits to FP32; cross_entropy reduction=sum divided by the identical count

protected_summary.primary: equal macro of same_color and color_mapping

runtime_identity.executable_source_ancestor: 6ef4b1a6515e7caf65fcdd1869f105bd1fb0e266 must be a Git ancestor of runtime HEAD
runtime_identity.launch_checkout: runtime clean HEAD on bound branch; recorded in raw evidence and terminal receipt
runtime_identity.reviewed_file_continuity: all executable/config/manifest hashes are verified before model import

strong_retention_family.selection_basis: Corrected V7 retention profile exact_rate=1.0; selection fixed before E03 gradients

sufficient_statistics.durable_output: global and target-module Gram matrices plus token/loss/episode metadata; no complete LoRA vector JSON or Git artifact
sufficient_statistics.partial_evidence: atomic PROGRESS.json after each B8/B1 basis block; failure receipt records partial status without scientific classification
sufficient_statistics.peak_scratch_bytes_formula: 45 * observed_lora_parameter_count * 4; runtime requires at least 2x this free disk before any backward pass
sufficient_statistics.success_cleanup: On complete evidence freeze, temporary memory maps are deleted before success receipt; on failure/cap they remain bounded partial evidence with PROGRESS.json.
sufficient_statistics.transient_storage: 45 float32 vector slots: 36 B8 microbatches plus 9 B1 family numerator reconstructions; memory-mapped scratch only
